## Objective

Connect full setup to real authorized host and owner qualification.

## Scope

- Native qualification bridge
- Guard bindings
- Curator session owner path
- Change-driven invalidation

## Entry conditions

- Governance, owners, runtimes and source products are prepared.

## Exit criteria

- Qualification requires real host/owner evidence.
- Pending work is retained correctly and stale dependent evidence is invalidated.

## Risks

- Static fixtures cannot impersonate native execution or current runtime authority.
- Session operation budgets and seals must remain intact.

## TASK-021 - Bind full setup to real native qualification

Add an operation-bound qualification handoff that lets the live authorized Director/Task manager supply genuine native orchestration, frozen-input and collaboration evidence to the existing setup transaction.

| Dependencies | TASK-020 |
| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- No shell-launched substitute agents, automatic production Tasks or shrinking of required teams.
- The responsible execution manager must obtain fresh role catalogs at actual assignment time.

### Acceptance criteria

- Full qualification records actual host capability, capacity, inherited effective settings and context independence; static CLI code never simulates launches.
- Real manager/child policy, grants, sealed inputs, addressed notification/read receipts and owner disposition bind the exact setup inputs; absent authority/tools leaves the stage incomplete.

### Planned verification

- Check admission rejects stale/wrong-project, fabricated or incomplete native evidence using narrow deterministic controls.
- Exercise the genuine authorized bounded team/exchange in Phase 9, preserving all required category participants and gates; reuse only exact still-current prior qualification.

## TASK-023 - Complete the live-session Curator owner path

Implement a bounded current-owner session route from observation to admitted maintenance receipt and delivery consumption, including projects without an independent Git repository.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-001, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-038 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_session.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_git.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_events.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_policy.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_filesystem.py (proposed), SKILLS-depo/curate/tests/test_session_maintenance.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/tests/test_direct_owner_routes.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_curator.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-022 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Current LocalGit requires the selected root be Git top-level; a configuration-only change cannot satisfy the new-project case.
- Version the new observation context explicitly; never weaken Git checks or forge Git identifiers.

### Acceptance criteria

- A current live owner can complete one genuinely eligible bounded operation with an attributable receipt; only its exact delivery is consumed and exhausted/unavailable work stays pending.
- A destination-confined filesystem observation profile supports a new non-repository project without Git creation or fabricated commits/branches; existing Git-backed identities/history retain their semantics.
- New profile identity, source freshness, no-follow access, owner grants and queue/recovery are reviewed together; unattended operation remains disabled.

### Planned verification

- Run focused session/owner-route checks for repository and non-repository roots, changed/replaced roots, budget exhaustion, pending delivery and explicit opt-out.
- In Phase 9 observe actual admission, owner operation and consumption; use a clearly separate genuine qualification change when production has no eligible work.

### Risks

- Do not clear another owner's pending obligations or rewrite old success receipts.

### Acceptance criteria

- A change marks only affected readiness and generated products stale until their owner operations renew them.
- Unrelated history and product work are not scanned or rewritten as a prerequisite; immutable original evidence remains attributable.

### Planned verification

- Test a changed owner adapter, changed Home source and changed corpus input against current/retained qualification.
- Confirm a change outside declared dependencies leaves unrelated evidence current and no reads perform repairs.
